pages.text: Caves have $(bold)no ore in the walls$(): Geolosys took every vanilla vein. So why go down? Two reasons.$(br2)The $(bold)deep deposits$() only exist there: galena, azurite, cinnabar, kimberlite, beryl, limonite, anthracite. Their samples sit on cave floors the way surface samples sit on grass.

And the $(bold)places$(): mineshafts and dungeons (YUNG's, rebuilt for every biome), Cataclysm's ruins and its Ancient Factory.$(br2)Every chest down there carries ore: clusters of iron, copper, zinc, gold and the rarer metals, coal, lapis, redstone, and sometimes a prospector's pick. The deeper the place, the more it pays.

Rumour maps to the deeper bosses turn up in the same chests. A mineshaft is a good first expedition: wood, rails, chests, and the way to the deposits below.$(br2)Bring a bed, torches and a dog. Mobs are smarter here than you remember.
